name: NTNU PhD Candidate Positions
host: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
amount: NOK 550,800/year gross (2026 postings, pay code 1017), minus 2% pension contribution
dlText: Positions advertised year-round with individual deadlines (Jobbnorge)
fields: All NTNU faculties (engineering, sciences, medicine, humanities, social sciences)
note: Each PhD candidate post is a salaried job advertised on NTNU's vacancies page/Jobbnorge; you must be admitted to an NTNU PhD programme within three months of starting.

name: University of Oslo Doctoral Research Fellow Positions
amount: State salary scale (code 1017), set in each posting; check official page
dlText: Positions advertised year-round with individual deadlines
note: Doctoral research fellowships at UiO are fixed-term jobs, normally four years with 25% career-enhancing work and three years of research training. Apply to individual vacancies under Academic positions.

name: University of Bergen PhD Research Fellow Positions
amount: NOK 568,700/year gross (late-2025 postings, code 1017) + NOK 36,000/year research allowance
dlText: Positions advertised year-round with individual deadlines (Jobbnorge)
fields: All UiB faculties (sciences, medicine, social sciences, humanities, arts)
note: Salary rises with length of service. Positions are posted by individual departments on UiB's vacancies/Jobbnorge.

name: UiT Doctoral Research Fellow Positions
host: UiT The Arctic University of Norway
amount: State salary code 1017 (starting level set in each posting); check official page
dlText: Positions advertised year-round with individual deadlines (Jobbnorge)
fields: All UiT faculties (incl. Arctic, marine, health and computer sciences)
note: PhD fellows at UiT are employees on the state salary scale; the standard term is four years with 25% teaching or other duties.

name: University of Tartu Doctoral Junior Research Fellow Positions
amount: Min. €2,100/month gross (2026; ≈€1,580 net) as junior research fellow
dlText: 30 Nov 2026 for the intake starting early 2027 (time not stated); several intakes a year
note: Most doctoral places come with a junior research fellow job; a few places are study-only without a salary, so check each call on the open-calls page.

name: TalTech Early Stage Researcher (PhD) Positions
amount: Min. €2,300/month gross for full-time early stage researchers (some projects pay more)
dlText: Positions and admissions year-round (two main matriculation periods)
fields: Engineering, ICT, natural sciences, business and governance
note: Doctoral students work as early stage researchers with a salary guaranteed for the nominal study period; positions are posted on TalTech's doctoral studies pages.

name: Vilnius University State-Funded Doctoral Places
dlText: Calls per field during the year (e.g. some 2026 calls closed 15 Dec, 12:00)

eligibility.note: Master's-degree holders; the page does not state whether non-EU applicants compete for state-funded places on equal terms. Confirm with admissions@cr.vu.lt.

note: State-funded full-time doctoral students get a Government-set monthly stipend; you can submit only one application for one topic.

name: KTU State-Funded Doctoral Studies
dlText: 2027 admission rules published Feb 2027; main admission normally June–July (some fields Feb/May)

eligibility.note: Master's-degree holders of any nationality may apply; places are allocated by competition score within quotas (eligibility of non-EU applicants for state-funded places not stated explicitly).

fields: KTU's 19 doctoral programmes (engineering, technology, natural and social sciences)
note: Self-funded students pay €12,680/year, so aim for a state-funded place. Almost half of KTU's doctoral applicants are foreigners.

name: University of Iceland Doctoral Grants Fund
dlText: ~1 Feb 2027 (estimated from 2026 cycle, time not stated); call usually published in early December
tags: Enrolled or prospective UI PhD students
Route C: apply with intended supervisor
fields: All University of Iceland doctoral fields
note: Prospective students apply together with an intended supervisor and must also apply to the PhD programme; projects are rated by an external reviewer and an internal panel.
